widgetSettings.title: Widget
widgetSettings.description: Customize your home screen widgets. Pick up to 3 habits for the weekly heatmap widget.
widgetSettings.noActiveHabits: No active habits. Create some habits first!
widgetSettings.limitBody: You can select up to 3 habits for the widget.
widgetSettings.howItWorksBody: After selecting habits, add the widgets to your home screen:
widgetSettings.iosSteps:
1. Touch and hold an empty area on your Home Screen
2. Tap the + button in the top-left corner
3. Search for "Habitic Widget"
4. Pick "Week Heatmap" (small/medium)
5. Choose a size
6. Tap "Add Widget"
widgetSettings.androidSteps:
1. Touch and hold an empty area on your Home Screen
2. Tap "Widgets"
3. Find "Habit Tracker" in the list
4. Drag the widget to your Home Screen
